# User arbitrations of the blocking report (verbatim, French)

Arbitrages (rapport bloquant, section 7) :

Q1 : (b). Ajouter à §63 « la destination est utilisable dans l'état d'arrivée ».
Q2 : lecture mixte sur l'état d'arrivée : invariants du noyau sur l'état entier, plus ArenaInv de la nouvelle entrée ; NewArenaBase porte cette lecture.
Q3 : réalisation par des pas du noyau. freeSlot (contrat HandlePool v0.5) marque l'entrée libre et incrémente la génération ; préconditions : droit d'administration, pool vivant, handle valide, aucune feuille de l'entrée à Init (Uninit ou Moved), aucune autorité active dérivée d'une compagne de ce pool sur l'entrée ; aucun effet d'endUse. Deux preuves obligatoires :
  (1) témoin complet depuis l'état initial par des pas autorisés : newPool, allocSlot, resolve Modify, écriture, transfer de la valeur vers un local de même forme, unresolve, freeSlot accepté ;
  (2) la mise à jour des métadonnées (état libre, génération) est réalisable par une écriture autorisée sous le droit d'administration.
Q4 : garantie par pool : réécrire D.2, D.3 et D.4(3) sur les compagnes du pool du slot ; les pools imbriqués restent permis ; I1 et les garanties du noyau restent prouvées sur l'état entier.
Q5 : la validation du handle précède le contrôle du droit : fail dans les deux cas.
Q6 : réécrire §86 s4 : « La réémission ne modifie ni les octets ni l'état d'initialisation. Une lecture reste soumise aux conditions ordinaires du modèle mémoire, notamment Init, aux droits d'accès et à la validité de représentation pour le type demandé. La Spec 4 déterminera les obligations de construction et de typage des valeurs réémises. »
Q7 : restreindre §78.3 aux ancres du sous-arbre strict de internal qui couvrent une feuille du stockage administré ; prouver que la clause découle de §78.2 et de I3 (lecture Q9), et l'équivalence de reset avec sa séquence du noyau dans les deux sens.
Q8 : ajouter à §47 : le graphe de possession des statiques est acyclique.
Q9 et Q26 : « valide » = active. §69.2 : endUse est rejeté si une autorité détenue par place a un descendant actif détenu ailleurs.
Q10 : (a).
Q11 : (a) fail ; (b) reject ; (c) reject ; (d) mark exige AdminRight ; (e) grow suit le détenteur actuel du bloc ; (f) fail avant le contrôle du droit (contrat DS-v2).
Q12 : avec le nouveau freeSlot, un handle d'entrée libre est périmé : fail.
Q13 : §71.2 inchangé ; préciser au §36 que MetaRight vise la création ou le recyclage d'autorités sur un stockage existant, pas la création d'une allocation fraîche par alloc ; la concurrence entre appels relève de la spec 2.
Q14 : « opérations d'accès » = O9–O11 ; le préciser au §59.
Q15 : restreindre §40 aux emplacements racines utilisables, comme §49.7.
Q16 : définir I5 : toute feuille épinglée appartient à un emplacement utilisable.
Q17 : lecture actuelle.
Q18 : région dont toutes les feuilles sont de taille nulle : base et provenance de l'allocation de l'ancre effective, comme la région vide.
Q19 : H31a : le jumeau à plusieurs pas (conjonct 5) est accepté.
Q20 : non bloquants (classés).
Q21 : pour chaque cas dont le verdict attendu change, conserver le verdict historique, sa justification et le nouveau verdict fondé sur la v0.1 (tableau dans la description de PR) :
  - H21, H50, H51 : nouveau verdict = verdict obtenu ;
  - H49 : conservé comme test de régression, verdict = verdict obtenu, blocage résiduel documenté (décision NoLock) ; exception explicite : le reset rejeté de H49 est dispensé de jumeau positif ;
  - H16 classé spec 3 ; W2 et W3 : les variantes deviennent les cas ; MM2-H H01 : la variante devient le jumeau ; H10 : l'accès sort de l'allocation ; W1 : la valeur est retirée avant freeSlot.
Q22 : non bloquants (frontières ouvertes de la spec) ; exitRoots retenu comme réalisation de référence.
Q23 : lectures dont un témoin du rapport change un verdict :
  - B#1, B#15, B#33, SP-A4, machine S1 et S2 : lectures actuelles conservées (B#15 imposée par Q9) ;
  - B#28 : remplacée par Q9 ;
  - B#45 : remplacée : chaque pin crée une obligation d'épinglage d'identité fraîche ; une feuille est épinglée tant qu'une obligation active la couvre ; unpin désigne une obligation et ne lève qu'elle ; K.ExternalDone porte sur cette obligation ;
  - H-R5 : sans objet ; DS-R1 à DS-R13 : tranchées par Q11, Q27 et Q28.
  Les lectures sans témoin de différence sont conservées.
Q24 : le fournisseur doit être un emplacement utilisable (§71.2).
Q25 : (b).
Q27 : (a).
Q28 : (c) fail (une pile morte invalide ses marques).

Spec : ne pas modifier `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.md`. Créer `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md` à partir de la v0, avec les amendements Q1, Q2, Q6, Q7, Q8, Q9/Q26, Q13, Q14, Q15, Q16, Q18, Q24 et B#45 (§74, §75), en anglais ; en-tête : « Edition v0.1 — corrective candidate, not yet validated », suivi de la liste des clauses modifiées. Commit séparé `docs(specs): add memory model v0.1 corrective candidate`. La reconstruction suit la v0.1.
Contrats locaux : HandlePool v0.5 (Q3, Q4, Q5, Q12) et DS-v2 (Q11, Q27, Q28), changements listés dans la description de PR.
Preuves : refaire celles qui sont touchées ; les garanties de Q1, Q3, Q7 et B#45 sont démontrées sur les états atteignables du contrat, sans hypothèse supplémentaire non normative ; tout échec de preuve est rapporté, jamais contourné. Ouvrir la PR si la condition du brief est remplie.

## Follow-up answers (verbatim, French)

Q9 (suite) : règle unifiée. endUse et free sont rejetés si une autorité qu'ils désactivent — détenue par un emplacement qui meurt, stockage possédé transitivement compris, ou racine d'un stockage libéré — a un descendant actif, quelle que soit son empreinte, que le même pas ne désactive pas. Les cas (1) et (2) sont donc rejetés. La sortie de cadre garde son ré-ancrage, et rejette si aucune origine survivante n'existe (inchangé). I2 au sens « origine active » tient après chaque pas.

Q3 (suite) : remplace Q17. Dans §63.4, §69.2 et §70.3, sont exemptées des contrôles « autorité dérivée active couvrant depuis l'extérieur » les autorités par lesquelles le pas exerce son droit Modify : l'autorité exerçable qui fonde le droit et sa chaîne d'origines (pour le pool : entrée, compagne, internal et ses origines). Les autres autorités actives restent contrôlées. Le témoin Q3 (1) devient : resolve Modify, écriture, transfer de l'entrée vers un local, unresolve, freeSlot accepté, y compris avec internal dérivé. W1 suit le même chemin. Réévaluer W2 sous cette lecture. Ajouter §63.4, §69.2 et §70.3 aux amendements de la v0.1.

(Cases (1) and (2) above refer to: (1) endUse(p) where p owns an allocation q holding a stored authority a, the frame holding b derived from a over another static; (2) free(p) with an empty-footprint derivative of p's root held by the frame.)

## Second follow-up answers (verbatim, French), after the library phase

HandlePool v0.5, freeSlot : remplacer la condition par « aucune autorité active, descendante stricte de internal de ce pool, ne couvre l'entrée ». Le ré-ancrage sur internal (§73) est alors couvert, et la garantie reste par pool : un pool imbriqué dans une entrée bloque la libération de cette entrée, alors que les autorités du pool parent ne bloquent pas les freeSlot du pool imbriqué, puisqu'elles sont des ancêtres de son internal et non des descendantes. pool_no_stale_access doit tenir sous cette règle.

DataStack :
- DS-R1 : toute cellule de position ≥ m.top (lecture la plus stricte) ;
- DS-R4 : grow avec extra = 0 est ok (réémission en place de la même région) ;

/-- The state after `o` from `C` when it is `ok`; `C` otherwise (§58). -/
def cnext (C : CState) (o : COp) : CState :=
  match cstep k C o with
  | .ok C' => C'
  | _ => C

/-- The state reached by `os` from `C` when every step is `ok` and every `allocSlot` handle write
is a kernel write (§58, §67); `none` otherwise. -/
def crun (C : CState) : List COp → Option CState
  | [] => some C
  | o :: os =>
    match cstep k C o with
    | .ok C' => if o.kok C then crun C' os else none
    | _ => none

/-- The state reached by `os` from `CState.init statics` (§47); `CState.init statics` when the run
does not complete (used only under `(crun …).isSome = true`, see `crunsTo`). -/
def cfinal (statics : Statics) (os : List COp) : CState :=
  (crun k (CState.init statics) os).getD (CState.init statics)

end Exec

/-- Combined library states reachable from `CState.init statics` (§47) by `ok` steps of the kernel
and of the three libraries (Part XIV; HandlePool v0.5; DS-v2). -/
inductive CReach (k : K) (statics : Statics) : CState → Prop where
  | init : CReach k statics (CState.init statics)
  | step {C C' : CState} {o : COp} : CReach k statics C → CRel k C o (.ok C') →
      CReach k statics C'

variable (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]

/-- A run of `os` from `CState.init statics` (§47) has only `ok` steps and reaches `C`; `C` is
library-reachable, and its kernel state is reachable by O1–O16 (§57; HandlePool v0.5, HP5-7). -/
structure CRunsTo (statics : Statics) (os : List COp) (C : CState) : Prop where
  /-- Every step is `ok` and the run ends in `C`. -/
  run : crun k (CState.init statics) os = some C
  /-- `C` is library-reachable. -/
  creach : CReach k statics C
  /-- The kernel state of `C` is reachable from `S3.init statics` by O1–O16 (§57). -/
  reach : Reachable k statics C.kern

/-- The run of `os` from `CState.init statics` has only `ok` steps (§47, §57). -/
abbrev CRuns (statics : Statics) (os : List COp) : Prop :=
  CRunsTo k statics os (cfinal k statics os)

end Runs

def Live (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop := s.Active E.internal

/-- Decidability of `Live` (§46). -/
instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Decidable (Live s E) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (s.Active _))

/-- Arena value (§46): the place holding `internal`. -/
def arenaValue (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Option Nat :=
  match s.A[E.internal]? with
  | some y => match y.holder with
    | .place v => some v
    | .frame _ => none
  | none => none

/-- `MetaRight(s, arena)` (§36, §77.1, §78.1): exercisable `Modify` over the arena value; there is
no `writeShared` branch. -/
def MetaRight (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop :=
  OptP (arenaValue s E) (fun v => HasRight s .modify v) False

/-- Decidability of `MetaRight` (§36). -/
instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Decidable (MetaRight s E) := by
  unfold MetaRight; infer_instance

/-- Available region (§46): each of its leaves belongs to `available`; the empty region is always
available. -/
def Avail (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) : Prop := ∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ E.available

/-- Decidability of `Avail` (§46). -/
instance (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) : Decidable (Avail E region) := by
  unfold Avail; infer_instance

structure S3 where
  F : Frames
  nF : Nat
  P : List Place
  I : Nat → InitSt
  A : List Authority
  D : Nat → List Nat
  dead : Nat → Bool
  pins : List PinOb

/-- Leaf `l` is dynamically pinned (§74): an active pinning obligation covers it. -/
def S3.pin (s : S3) (l : Nat) : Bool := s.pins.any fun o => o.active && o.leaves.contains l

/-- Shape of the locals of `enterFrame` (§72) and of an allocation (§71.1): each element is an
optional structural parent (a place index) and a `kind`. Every element is owned by the holder
receiving the shape. -/
abbrev LocalShape := List (Option Nat × Nat)

/-- External contract `K` (§48, §80): `DeclaredDisjoint` on regions (§23, §61.3);
`SharedMutable` and `Pinned` on leaves (§68.1, §63.5); `ExternalDone` on dynamic pinning
obligations, by identity (§75); `Deallocable` on places (§70.2); `FreeCompat place auth` (§70.2);
`Satisfiable provider shape s` (§71). Obligations of `K` are hypotheses of theorems, never
fields. -/
def HasRight (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.ExercisableAt a m ∧
    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, Allows (effective s a l) m

/-- Decidability of `HasRight` (§43). -/
instance (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q : Nat) : Decidable (HasRight s m q) := by
  unfold HasRight; infer_instance

/-- Authority `g` grounds the right `HasRight(s, m, q)` (§43; §63.4, §69.2, §70.3: "the
exercisable authority on which that right rests"): it is exercisable at `m` and its effective mode
permits `m` on every leaf of `q`'s footprint. -/
def Grounds (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q g : Nat) : Prop :=
  g ∈ List.range s.A.length ∧ s.ExercisableAt g m ∧
    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, Allows (effective s g l) m

/-- Decidability of `Grounds` (§63.4, §69.2, §70.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q g : Nat) : Decidable (Grounds s m q g) := by
  unfold Grounds; infer_instance

/-- Authority `j` is the grounding authority `g` or belongs to its origin chain (§63.4, §69.2,
§70.3: "the exercisable authority on which that right rests and its origin chain"). -/
def RightChain (s : S3) (g j : Nat) : Prop := j = g ∨ j ∈ s.ancs g

/-- Decidability of `RightChain` (§63.4, §69.2, §70.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (g j : Nat) : Decidable (RightChain s g j) := by
  unfold RightChain; infer_instance
  decidable_of_iff ((∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l) ∧ (∀ l ∈ ls, s.I l = .init) ∧
    s.ExercisableAt a .observe ∧ (∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l ≠ none) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-- `read` as a relation (§66): the state is unchanged. -/
def Read3Step (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (Read3Pre s a ls) s

/-- Preconditions of an ordinary `write` of the leaves `ls` through `access` (§67). The type,
storage and abstraction constraints of §67.3 are not represented. -/
structure Write3Pre (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §67.1: targeted leaves belong to usable places. -/
  usable : ∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l
  /-- §67.1: `access` is exercisable in `Modify`. -/
  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt a .modify
  /-- §67.1: `access` has effective `Modify` over each leaf. -/
  effectiveModify : ∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l = some .modify
  /-- §67.2: no other authority holds an effective mode, all incompatible with `Modify` (§50),
  over the written leaves. -/
  exclusive : ∀ l ∈ ls, ∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, b ≠ a → effective s b l = none
  /-- §67.3: anchors remain valid. -/
  anchorsValid : ∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `write` (§67). -/
instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Decidable (Write3Pre s a ls) :=
  decidable_of_iff ((∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l) ∧ s.ExercisableAt a .modify ∧
    (∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l = some .modify) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ ls, ∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, b ≠ a → effective s b l = none) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-- Effect of a write (§67, §68, `ok` effect): the written leaves become `Init`. -/
def write3Eff (s : S3) (ls : List Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with I := fun p => if p ∈ ls then .init else s.I p }

/-- `write` as a relation (§67). -/
def Write3Step (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (Write3Pre s a ls) (write3Eff s ls)

/-- Preconditions of `writeShared` of the leaves `ls` through `access` (§68). -/
structure WriteSharedPre (k : K) (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §68.1: every leaf of the region is usable (belongs to a usable place). -/
  usable : ∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l
  /-- §68.1: every leaf of the region is declared `K.SharedMutable`. -/
  shared : ∀ l ∈ ls, k.SharedMutable l
inductive KStep (k : K) : S3 → S3 → Prop where
  | derive {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {region : List Nat} {m : Mode} :
      DeriveStep src region m s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | split {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {rs : List (List Nat)} :
      SplitStep k src rs s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | release {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} : ReleaseStep a s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | transfer {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | depend {s s' : S3} {q x : Nat} : DependStep q x s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | enter {s s' : S3} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape} :
      EnterStep ps ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | exit {s s' : S3} : ExitStep k s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | read {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} : Read3Step a ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | write {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} : Write3Step a ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | writeShared {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} :
      WriteSharedStep k a ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | pin {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : PinStep p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | unpin {s s' : S3} {o : Nat} : UnpinStep k o s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | endUse {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : EndUseStep k p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | free {s s' : S3} {p auth : Nat} : FreeStep k p auth s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | alloc {s s' : S3} {pr ow : Nat} {ls : LocalShape} :
      AllocStep k pr ow ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | store {s s' : S3} {a p : Nat} : StoreStep a p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'

end Ern.MemoryModel.Access

content.content:
gen : Nat
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Ghost record of a resolution (HandlePool v0.5, D.2; auxiliary information creating no right,
§38): pool identity and `internal`, the companion, the mode, and the entry authorities tagged with
their slot and resolved generation. Read by `unresolve` and by the invariants. -/
structure Res where
  pool : Nat
  internal : Nat
  comp : Nat
  mode : Mode
  entries : List (Nat × Nat × Nat)
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Library state (§38, §46; HandlePool v0.5, D.1; non-normative library contract): the kernel
state `S₃` and, separately, the pool registry, the next fresh pool identity and the ghost
resolutions. -/
structure PState where
  kern : S3
  pools : List Pool
  nId : Nat
  res : List Res

/-- Initial library state (§47; HandlePool v0.5, D.1): the initial kernel state, an empty
registry. -/
def PState.init (statics : Statics) : PState := ⟨S3.init statics, [], 0, []⟩

/-- The pool read as an arena entry with nothing available or issued, to reuse `MetaRight` of §36
(HandlePool v0.5, D.3; non-normative library contract). -/
def Pool.entry (pl : Pool) : Arena.ArenaEntry := ⟨pl.storage, pl.internal, [], []⟩

/-- Administration right on the pool (§36; HandlePool v0.5, D.3 corrected by §36, HP5-1;
non-normative library contract): the pool is live (`internal` active) and `MetaRight` holds,
exercisable `Modify` over the pool value; no `writeShared` branch. -/
def AdminRight (s : S3) (pl : Pool) : Prop := s.Active pl.internal ∧ Arena.MetaRight s pl.entry

/-- Decidability of `AdminRight` (§36; HandlePool v0.5, D.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (pl : Pool) : Decidable (AdminRight s pl) := by
  unfold AdminRight; infer_instance

/-- Place of slot `i`, `0` if absent (HandlePool v0.5, D.1; non-normative library contract;
§46). -/
def slotPlace (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) : Nat := ((pl.slots[i]?).map (·.place)).getD 0

/-- The pool with slot `i` replaced (HandlePool v0.5, D.3; non-normative library contract;
§46). -/
def setSlot (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) (sl : Slot) : Pool := { pl with slots := pl.slots.set i sl }

/-! ## `newPool` (HandlePool v0.5, D.1; §56, §76) -/

/-- The pool registry as a registry of live administrations (§56; HandlePool v0.5, D.1;
non-normative library contract): the `internal` identities of its live pools. -/
def liveInternals (s : S3) (pools : List Pool) : List Nat :=
  (pools.filter fun pl => decide (s.Active pl.internal)).map (·.internal)

/-- Preconditions of `newPool(storage, internal)` (HandlePool v0.5, D.1; non-normative library
contract; §56, §76). -/
structure NewPoolPre (s : S3) (pools : List Pool) (others : List (List Nat))
    (storage internal : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- HandlePool v0.5, D.1: "reprend les autres obligations applicables de `newArena`"
  (§76.1–§76.3, §76.5, §76.6, read on the resulting state as v0.1 §76.6 states it). -/
  base : Arena.NewArenaBase s storage internal
  /-- HandlePool v0.5, D.1: every leaf of the input storage is `Uninit`. -/
  uninit : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P storage, s.I l = .uninit
  /-- HandlePool v0.5, D.1, §56: `internal` is absent from the pool registry and from every other
  registry of live administrations `others`. -/
  guard : Arena.Guard56 (liveInternals s pools :: others) internal

/-- Decidability of `NewPoolPre` (HandlePool v0.5, D.1; §56, §76). -/
instance (s : S3) (pools : List Pool) (others : List (List Nat)) (storage internal : Nat) :
    Decidable (NewPoolPre s pools others storage internal) :=
  decidable_of_iff (Arena.NewArenaBase s storage internal ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P storage, s.I l = .uninit) ∧
    Arena.Guard56 (liveInternals s pools :: others) internal)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c⟩ => ⟨a, b, c⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c⟩ => ⟨a, b, c⟩⟩

/-- Effect of `newPool` (HandlePool v0.5, D.1; non-normative library contract): a pool with the
fresh identity `nId`, one free slot of generation zero per child of the storage, the kernel state
unchanged (§46, §76). -/
def newPoolEff (L : PState) (storage internal : Nat) : PState :=
  { L with

DerivePre (compS L.kern pl m) L.kern.A.length (footprint L.kern.P sl.place) m →
      ResolveStep j h m L (.ok { L with
        kern := deriveEff (compS L.kern pl m) L.kern.A.length (footprint L.kern.P sl.place) m
        res := L.res ++ [⟨pl.id, pl.internal, L.kern.A.length, m,
          [(L.kern.A.length + 1, h.slot, h.gen)]⟩] })

/-- Validity of a batch (HandlePool v0.5, D.2, HP5-5; non-normative library contract): every
handle is valid (`HandleOK`); pairwise distinct slots in `Modify` only (§58, §89). -/
def BatchOK (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (hs : List Handle) (m : Mode) : Prop :=
  (∀ h ∈ hs, HandleOK s pl h) ∧ (m = .modify → (hs.map (·.slot)).Nodup)

/-- Decidability of `BatchOK` (HandlePool v0.5, D.2; §58, §89). -/
instance (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (hs : List Handle) (m : Mode) : Decidable (BatchOK s pl hs m) := by
  unfold BatchOK; infer_instance

/-- `resolveMany(hs, m)` on pool `j` as a relation (HandlePool v0.5, D.2, HP5-5; §58;
non-normative library contract): `reject` without the pool; then an atomic `fail` for an invalid
batch, before the right is checked (HP5-5); then `reject` without the legal exercise of
`internal`; then one companion and the entry authorities (`EntriesPre`), `reject` when they are
not accepted. -/
inductive ResolveManyStep (k : K) (j : Nat) (hs : List Handle) (m : Mode) (L : PState) :
    Outcome3 PState → Prop where
  | noPool : L.pools[j]? = none → ResolveManyStep k j hs m L .reject
  | fail {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → ¬ BatchOK L.kern pl hs m →
      ResolveManyStep k j hs m L .fail
  | noRight {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → BatchOK L.kern pl hs m →
      ¬ ResolveRight L.kern pl m → ResolveManyStep k j hs m L .reject
  | noEntries {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → BatchOK L.kern pl hs m →
      ResolveRight L.kern pl m →
      ¬ EntriesPre k m (compS L.kern pl m) L.kern.A.length (entryRegions L.kern pl hs) →
      ResolveManyStep k j hs m L .reject
  | ok {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → BatchOK L.kern pl hs m → ResolveRight L.kern pl m →
      EntriesPre k m (compS L.kern pl m) L.kern.A.length (entryRegions L.kern pl hs) →
      ResolveManyStep k j hs m L (.ok { L with
        kern := entriesEff m (compS L.kern pl m) L.kern.A.length (entryRegions L.kern pl hs)
        res := L.res ++ [⟨pl.id, pl.internal, L.kern.A.length, m,
          batchEntries L.kern.A.length hs⟩] })

/-! ## `unresolve` (HandlePool v0.5, D.2) -/

/-- Releases the authorities of a list in order (§62); `none` as soon as one release is not
accepted (HandlePool v0.5, D.2: "Les règles de `release` … restent applicables"). -/
def releaseAll : S3 → List Nat → Option S3
  | s, [] => some s
  | s, a :: l => if ReleasePre s a then releaseAll (releaseEff s a) l else none

/-- The resolution of companion `c` (HandlePool v0.5, D.2; ghost lookup, §38). -/
def findRes (L : PState) (c : Nat) : Option Res := L.res.find? fun r => r.comp == c

/-- Authorities released by `unresolve` of `r` (HandlePool v0.5, D.2; non-normative library
contract): the entry authorities still active, then the companion (§62). -/
def unresolveList (s : S3) (r : Res) : List Nat :=
  ((r.entries.map (·.1)).filter fun a => decide (s.Active a)) ++ [r.comp]

/-- `unresolve(c)` as a relation (HandlePool v0.5, D.2; §58; non-normative library contract): the
releases of `unresolveList`; `reject` when one is not accepted or `c` is no companion. -/
inductive UnresolveStep (c : Nat) (L : PState) : Outcome3 PState → Prop where
  | none : findRes L c = none → UnresolveStep c L .reject
  | reject {r : Res} : findRes L c = some r → releaseAll L.kern (unresolveList L.kern r) = none →
      UnresolveStep c L .reject
  | ok {r : Res} {s' : S3} : findRes L c = some r →
      releaseAll L.kern (unresolveList L.kern r) = some s' →
      UnresolveStep c L (.ok { L with kern := s' })

/-! ## `freeSlot` (HandlePool v0.5, D.3 as amended by HP5-1, HP5-1', HP5-1'') -/

/-- No active strict descendant of the `internal` of pool `pl` covers a leaf of place `q`
(HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1 as amended by HP5-1': "aucune autorité active, descendante stricte de
internal de ce pool, ne couvre l'entrée"; §42: descendants along the current origin chain, which
covers the reanchoring of §73.4 onto `internal`; non-normative library contract). -/
def NoInternalDesc (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (q : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.Active x → pl.internal ∈ s.ancs x →
    ∀ l ∈ s.afp x, l ∉ footprint s.P q

/-- Decidability of `NoInternalDesc` (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1'; §42). -/
instance (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (q : Nat) : Decidable (NoInternalDesc s pl q) := by
  unfold NoInternalDesc; infer_instance

/-- Content conditions of `freeSlot` on slot place `q` of pool `pl` (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1,
HP5-1'; non-normative library contract; §41, §42). -/
structure FreeContentOK (L : PState) (pl : Pool) (q : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1: no leaf of the entry is `Init`; each is `Uninit` or `Moved`
  (§41). -/
  notInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint L.kern.P q, L.kern.I l ≠ .init
  /-- HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1': no active strict descendant of `internal` of this pool covers a
  leaf of the entry (§42). -/
  noDesc : NoInternalDesc L.kern pl q

/-- Decidability of `FreeContentOK` (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1, HP5-1'; §41, §42). -/
instance (L : PState) (pl : Pool) (q : Nat) : Decidable (FreeContentOK L pl q) :=
  decidable_of_iff ((∀ l ∈ footprint L.kern.P q, L.kern.I l ≠ .init) ∧ NoInternalDesc L.kern pl q)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩, fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩⟩

/-- Metadata leaves of pool `pl` (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1 as amended by arbitration Q3, decision
of 2026-11-06; non-normative library contract; §46 analogue, §36): the leaves (§40) of the pool
value, the place holding `internal` (`Arena.arenaValue`); empty when `internal` is absent or held
by a frame, a case `AdminRight` excludes. -/
def metaLeaves (s : S3) (pl : Pool) : List Nat :=
  match Arena.arenaValue s pl.entry with
  | some v => footprint s.P v
  | none => []

/-- The metadata leaves are the leaves of the pool value (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1, Q3 decision of
2026-11-06; §46 analogue, §40). -/
theorem metaLeaves_of {s : S3} {pl : Pool} {v : Nat} (h : Arena.arenaValue s pl.entry = some v) :
    metaLeaves s pl = footprint s.P v := by
  unfold metaLeaves; rw [h]

/-- Effect of `freeSlot` on slot `i` of pool `j` (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1 as amended by arbitration
Q3, decision of 2026-11-06; non-normative library contract): the kernel write of the metadata
leaves (§67 effect: they become `Init`), then the abstract update: the slot becomes free and its
generation is incremented. There is no end-of-use effect, and the library adds no rights to the
kernel (§36). -/
def freeSlotEff (L : PState) (j : Nat) (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) (sl : Slot) : PState :=
  { L with
    kern := write3Eff L.kern (metaLeaves L.kern pl)
    pools := L.pools.set j (setSlot pl i ⟨sl.place, sl.gen + 1, false⟩) }

/-- `freeSlot(h)` on pool `j` as a relation (HandlePool v0.5, D.3 corrected by §36, HP5-1; outcome
order of HP5-1'' (Q5 extended to `freeSlot`); §58, §89; non-normative library contract): `reject`
without the pool; then `fail` for a handle of a dead pool, of another pool, stale, absent or free,
before the right is checked; then `reject` without the administration right (live pool and
`MetaRight`); then `reject` unless the content conditions hold (`FreeContentOK`); then `ok`, whose
effect is `freeSlotEff` (the write of the metadata leaves, Q3 decision of 2026-11-06). As for
`allocSlot`, the preconditions of that kernel write (§67) are not fields of the step: they follow
from `AdminRight` under `KInv` (`meta_write_of_kinv`). -/
inductive FreeSlotStep (j : Nat) (h : Handle) (L : PState) : Outcome3 PState → Prop where
  | noPool : L.pools[j]? = none → FreeSlotStep j h L .reject
  | fail {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → ¬ HandleOK L.kern pl h → FreeSlotStep j h L .fail
  | noRight {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → HandleOK L.kern pl h → ¬ AdminRight L.kern pl →
      FreeSlotStep j h L .reject
  | noContent {pl : Pool} {sl : Slot} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → HandleOK L.kern pl h →
      AdminRight L.kern pl → pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl → ¬ FreeContentOK L pl sl.place →
      FreeSlotStep j h L .reject
  | ok {pl : Pool} {sl : Slot} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → HandleOK L.kern pl h →
      AdminRight L.kern pl → pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl → FreeContentOK L pl sl.place →
      FreeSlotStep j h L (.ok (freeSlotEff L j pl h.slot sl))

/-! ## Library runs (HandlePool v0.5; §38, §46, §47) -/

/-- One `ok` step of a library run (HandlePool v0.5; non-normative library contract): a kernel
step O1–O16 of non-administrative code, the registry unchanged, or an accepted pool operation
(§58). -/
inductive PStep (k : K) : PState → PState → Prop where
  | kernel {L : PState} {s' : S3} : KStep k L.kern s' → PStep k L { L with kern := s' }
  | newPool {L L' : PState} {others : List (List Nat)} {st i : Nat} :
      NewPoolStep others st i L (.ok L') → PStep k L L'
  | allocSlot {L L' : PState} {j dst : Nat} : AllocSlotStep j dst L (.ok L') → PStep k L L'
  | resolve {L L' : PState} {j : Nat} {h : Handle} {m : Mode} :
      ResolveStep j h m L (.ok L') → PStep k L L'
  | resolveMany {L L' : PState} {j : Nat} {hs : List Handle} {m : Mode} :
      ResolveManyStep k j hs m L (.ok L') → PStep k L L'
  | unresolve {L L' : PState} {c : Nat} : UnresolveStep c L (.ok L') → PStep k L L'
  | freeSlot {L L' : PState} {j : Nat} {h : Handle} : FreeSlotStep j h L (.ok L') →
      PStep k L L'

/-- Library states reachable from the initial library state (§47) by library steps
(HandlePool v0.5; non-normative library contract). -/
inductive PReach (k : K) (statics : Statics) : PState → Prop where
  | init : PReach k statics (PState.init statics)
  | step {L L' : PState} : PReach k statics L → PStep k L L' → PReach k statics L'

/-! ## Kernel side of the pool operations (§57, §58; HandlePool v0.5, HP5-7) -/

/-- Finite sequences of kernel steps O1–O16 (§57, §58; HandlePool v0.5, HP5-7). -/
inductive KSeq (k : K) : S3 → S3 → Prop where
  | refl (s : S3) : KSeq k s s
  | tail {s s₁ s₂ : S3} : KSeq k s s₁ → KStep k s₁ s₂ → KSeq k s s₂

/-- Sequences of kernel steps compose (§57; HandlePool v0.5, HP5-7). -/
theorem KSeq.trans {k : K} {s₁ s₂ s₃ : S3} (h₁ : KSeq k s₁ s₂) (h₂ : KSeq k s₂ s₃) :

theorem KSeq.trans {k : K} {s₁ s₂ s₃ : S3} (h₁ : KSeq k s₁ s₂) (h₂ : KSeq k s₂ s₃) :
    KSeq k s₁ s₃ := by
  induction h₂ with
  | refl => exact h₁
  | tail _ hs ih => exact .tail ih hs

/-- One kernel step is a sequence (§57; HandlePool v0.5, HP5-7). -/
theorem KSeq.single {k : K} {s s' : S3} (h : KStep k s s') : KSeq k s s' := .tail (.refl s) h

/-- Kernel reachability (§57) is closed under sequences of kernel steps (HandlePool v0.5,
HP5-7). -/
theorem KSeq.reachable {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s s' : S3} (hr : Reachable k statics s)
    (h : KSeq k s s') : Reachable k statics s' := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact hr
  | tail _ hs ih => exact .step ih hs

/-- `releaseAll` is a sequence of `release` steps (§62; HandlePool v0.5, D.2). -/
theorem releaseAll_kseq {k : K} : ∀ {s s' : S3} {l : List Nat}, releaseAll s l = some s' →
    KSeq k s s'
  | s, s', [], h => by simp only [releaseAll, Option.some.injEq] at h; subst h; exact .refl s
  | s, s', a :: l, h => by
    simp only [releaseAll] at h
    split at h
    · rename_i hpre
      exact (KSeq.single (.release (Guarded.ok hpre))).trans (releaseAll_kseq h)
    · cases h

/-- The `Observe` derivations of `resolveMany` are a sequence of `derive` steps (§60;
HandlePool v0.5, D.2). -/
theorem derives_kseq {k : K} {c : Nat} : ∀ {s : S3} {rs : List (List Nat)}, DerivesPre s c rs →
    KSeq k s (derivesEff s c rs)
  | s, [], _ => .refl s
  | _, _ :: _, ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ => (KSeq.single (.derive (Guarded.ok h₁))).trans (derives_kseq h₂)

/-- The entry authorities of `resolveMany` are a `split` (§61) or a sequence of `derive` steps
(§60) (HandlePool v0.5, D.2). -/
theorem entries_kseq {k : K} {m : Mode} {s : S3} {c : Nat} {rs : List (List Nat)}
    (h : EntriesPre k m s c rs) : KSeq k s (entriesEff m s c rs) := by
  cases m with
  | modify => exact KSeq.single (.split (Guarded.ok h))
  | observe => exact derives_kseq h

/-- Under `KInv` (§57), an authority `a` exercisable in `Modify` with effective `Modify` over every
leaf of a usable place `q` satisfies the preconditions of an ordinary write (§67) of any leaves of
`q` (HandlePool v0.5, D.3: the write of the handle; HP5-3: the write of the pool value). -/
theorem write_of_right {s : S3} (hk : KInv s) {q a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} (hu : s.Usable q)
    (hex : s.ExercisableAt a .modify)
    (hall : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, Allows (effective s a l) .modify)
    (hls : ∀ l ∈ ls, l ∈ footprint s.P q) : Write3Pre s a ls := by
  refine ⟨fun l hl => ⟨q, List.mem_range.2 hu.lt, hu, hls l hl⟩, hex,
    fun l hl => Arena.allows_modify_iff.1 (hall l (hls l hl)),
    fun l hl b _ hb => effective_exclusive hk.2.1.1.1 (Ne.symm hb)
      (Arena.allows_modify_iff.1 (hall l (hls l hl))), fun l hl => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨-, -, hlq⟩ := mem_footprint.1 (hls l hl)
  have hul : s.Usable l := usable_of_partOf hk.1 (l + 1) l q (Nat.lt_succ_self l) hlq hu
  exact fun q' _ hq' x hx => hk.2.1.1.2.2.1 q' (usable_of_part hk.1 hq' hul) x hx

/-- The metadata write of `freeSlot` under `KInv` (§57) (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1 as amended by
arbitration Q3, decision of 2026-11-06; §36, §43, §67): for a pool with `AdminRight`, `internal` is
held by the pool value `v`, the metadata leaves are the leaves of `v`, an authority `a` grounds
`MetaRight` (`Grounds`: exercisable `Modify` with effective `Modify` over every leaf of `v`), and
the ordinary write of the metadata leaves through `a` satisfies the preconditions of §67. -/
theorem meta_write_of_kinv {s : S3} (hk : KInv s) {pl : Pool} (hR : AdminRight s pl) :
    ∃ v a, Arena.arenaValue s pl.entry = some v ∧ metaLeaves s pl = footprint s.P v ∧
      Grounds s .modify v a ∧ Write3Pre s a (metaLeaves s pl) := by
  obtain ⟨⟨y, hy, ya⟩, hm⟩ := hR
  unfold Arena.MetaRight at hm
  cases hv : Arena.arenaValue s pl.entry with
  | none => rw [hv] at hm; exact (hm : False).elim
  | some v =>
    rw [hv] at hm
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hex, hall⟩ : HasRight s .modify v := hm
    have hhold : y.holder = .place v := by
      simp only [Arena.arenaValue, Pool.entry, hy] at hv
      revert hv; cases y.holder <;> simp
    have hu : s.Usable v := by
      have := hk.1.holders _ y hy ya; rw [hhold] at this; exact this
    have hml := metaLeaves_of hv
    exact ⟨v, a, rfl, hml, ⟨ha, hex, hall⟩,
      hml ▸ write_of_right hk hu hex hall fun _ h => h⟩

/-- What a pool step is on the kernel side (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-7; §57, §58): under `KInv`, every
library step is a finite sequence of accepted kernel steps O1–O16: `newPool` none (the identity),
`allocSlot` one `write` (§67) of the handle, `freeSlot` one `write` (§67) of the metadata leaves
through the authority on which `MetaRight` rests (HP5-1 as amended by arbitration Q3, decision of
2026-11-06), `resolve` two `derive` (§60), `resolveMany` one `derive` then one `split` (§61) or one
`derive` per handle, `unresolve` `release` steps (§62). -/
theorem pstep_kernel {k : K} {L L' : PState} (hk : KInv L.kern) (h : PStep k L L') :
    KSeq k L.kern L'.kern := by
  cases h with
  | kernel hs => exact KSeq.single hs
  | newPool hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact .refl _
  | allocSlot hs =>
    cases hs with
    | ok _ hst _ _ =>
      obtain ⟨a, -, hex, hall⟩ := hst.dstRight
      exact KSeq.single (.write (a := a) (Guarded.ok (write_of_right hk hst.dstUsable hex hall
        fun l hl => by
          rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hl]
          exact mem_footprint.2 ⟨hst.dstUsable.lt, hst.dstLeaf, hst.dstUsable.lt, .inl rfl⟩)))
  | resolve hs =>
    cases hs with
    | ok _ _ hR _ hE =>
      exact (KSeq.single (.derive (Guarded.ok hR))).tail (.derive (Guarded.ok hE))
  | resolveMany hs =>
    cases hs with
    | ok _ _ hR hE => exact (KSeq.single (.derive (Guarded.ok hR))).trans (entries_kseq hE)
  | unresolve hs =>
    cases hs with
    | ok _ hr => exact releaseAll_kseq hr
  | freeSlot hs =>
    cases hs with
    | ok _ _ hR _ _ =>
      obtain ⟨-, a, -, -, -, hw⟩ := meta_write_of_kinv hk hR
      exact KSeq.single (.write (a := a) (Guarded.ok hw))

/-- The kernel state of every library-reachable state is reachable from `S3.init statics` by
kernel steps O1–O16 (§57; HandlePool v0.5, HP5-7), under `DDSound` (§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47),
which give `KInv` on the kernel side of the run (`Access.reachable_kinv`). -/
theorem pReach_reachable {k : K} {statics : Statics} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    {L : PState} (h : PReach k statics L) : Reachable k statics L.kern := by
  induction h with
  | init => exact .init
  | step _ hs ih => exact (pstep_kernel (reachable_kinv hdd hst ih) hs).reachable ih

/-- The guarantee of §57 on the kernel side of library runs (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-7, O5.g;
non-normative library contract): every kernel state of a library-reachable state satisfies
`KInv`. -/
def KernelGuarantee (k : K) (statics : Statics) : Prop := ∀ L, PReach k statics L → KInv L.kern

/-- `KernelGuarantee` holds under `DDSound` (§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47) (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-7;
§57): the kernel state of a library-reachable state is kernel-reachable (`pReach_reachable`). -/
theorem kernel_guarantee {k : K} {statics : Statics} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics) :
    KernelGuarantee k statics :=
  fun _ h => reachable_kinv hdd hst (pReach_reachable hdd hst h)

/-! ## Helper lemmas (lists, chains, effects) -/

/-- An optional value satisfying a predicate with default `False` exists (§38; HandlePool v0.5). -/
theorem optP_false_iff {α : Type} {o : Option α} {P : α → Prop} :
    OptP o P False ↔ ∃ y, o = some y ∧ P y := by
  cases o with
  | none => simp [OptP]
  | some y => simp [OptP]

/-- The replaced element belongs to the list (HandlePool v0.5, D.3: pool updates; §46). -/
theorem mem_set_self' {α : Type} : ∀ {l : List α} {i : Nat} {a x : α}, l[i]? = some a →
    x ∈ l.set i x
  | [], _, _, _, h => by simp at h
  | _ :: _, 0, _, _, _ => by simp

/-- Base of `pool_two_freeSlot_cross` (§72, §71, §60, §65; HandlePool v0.5, D.1): frame 1 with
the allocator 0, the pool value 1 and the leaves 2, 3, 4; storage 5 (entries 6, 7) owned by 1,
pool 0 on it with `internal` its root 5; then 6, `Modify` on the whole storage from 5, stored into
the leaf 4. -/
def pxo : List COp := [.enter [] [lf, lf, lf, lf, lf], .write 0 [0], .write 1 [1],
  .alloc 0 1 [lf, pt 5, pt 5], .newPool 5 5, .derive 5 [6, 7] .modify, .store 6 4]
/-- State reached by `pxo` (§57). -/
def px : CState := cfinal K0 [] pxo
/-- The twin of `pool_two_freeSlot_cross` continued as the draft witness, up to its `freeSlot`:
pool 1 on `internal` 6 over the same storage; slot 0 allocated in each pool (the place 6 in both);
the leaf 6 written through 6. -/
def pxwo : List COp := pxo ++ [.newPool 5 6, .allocSlot 0 2, .allocSlot 1 3, .write 6 [6]]
/-- State reached by `pxwo` (§57). -/
def pxw : CState := cfinal K0 [] pxwo
/-- The same continuation without the write, then `freeSlot` of slot 0 of pool 1 (HandlePool
v0.5, HP5-1). -/
def pxto : List COp := pxo ++ [.newPool 5 6, .allocSlot 0 2, .allocSlot 1 3, .freeSlot 1 ⟨1, 0, 0⟩]
/-- State reached by `pxto` (§57). -/
def pxt : CState := cfinal K0 [] pxto

/-- **pool_two_freeSlot_cross** (handle-pool contract, class Lib). A second pool on the `internal`
5 of the live pool 0, over the same storage. Expected (§56; HandlePool v0.5, D.1: "Une autorité ne
peut être `internal` de deux abstractions vivantes"): `reject` at the second `newPool`. Obtained:
`reject`; the other preconditions hold. Twin, the second pool on the distinct `internal` 6 (§56:
distinct identities over overlapping footprints are not forbidden): `ok`.

That twin continued as the draft witness: each pool allocates its slot 0, the place 6; the leaf 6
is written through 6; then `freeSlot` of slot 0 of pool 1. Historical verdict of this `freeSlot`:
`ok`, ending the content of the place 6, a live slot of pool 0 (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3: the
`internal` 5 of pool 0, an ancestor of the `internal` 6 of pool 1, is exempt). New verdict:
`reject` (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1: no leaf of the entry may be `Init`; the leaf 6 is `Init`).
Obtained: `reject`. Twin without the write: `ok`; the leaf 6 stays `Uninit` and the slot 0 of
pool 0 stays live at generation 0 (the kernel write of `freeSlot` covers only the leaf 4, the value

## 38. Machine State

The access discipline is based on the finite state

\[ S_3=(F,P,I,A,D) \]

where `F` represents the frame stack, `P` the places, `I` their initialization, `A` the authorities, and `D` the validity anchors. Administrative states of arenas and other library abstractions are separate from `S₃`. The external contract `K` is a separate parameter. The internal representation may carry auxiliary information that creates no new rights.

## 39. Execution Frames
## 58. Transition Outcomes

Every operation has a conceptual outcome among:

```text
Outcome3 = ok(new_state) | reject | fail
```

`reject` means that the static discipline does not permit the step; it is neither an implicit runtime trap nor `ub` in the elementary memory machine. `fail` is a **defined failure** leaving the state unchanged; **only `alloc` may produce it in the O1–O16 kernel**. Other kernel operations produce `ok` or `reject`. Library-abstraction operations, including `issue` (§77), may define their own `fail` cases. Where such failure is provided, static preconditions are checked before dynamic availability, according to the operation's contract.

An `ok` transition must satisfy its preconditions, apply exactly its prescribed effects, and preserve the relevant invariants. No transition fabricates a permission to make its conclusion true. Holder and anchor changes are evaluated in the **resulting state** when a rule explicitly so provides.

## 59. Implicit Preservation of Modes and Anchors

Changes in effective authority are **derived** from active authorities and their origins; no `Suspended` indicator is mutated. Access operations (O9–O11) do not change an anchor without an explicitly authorized effect of transfer, `depend`, `store`, release, or reanchoring. Leaves becoming `Init` do so through a permitted write (`write3`, `writeShared`, `store`, including during a derived `issue`) or a transfer from a corresponding source leaf already `Init`; leaves initialized in `S3.init` are declared as such.

content.text:
**Verdict: changes.** Nothing blocks. Proofs (a) and (b) are complete. Proof (c) is only partly proven, and the choice of metadata leaves should be recorded as the reading taken.

**What checks out**
- `pstep_kernel` (HandlePool.lean:580-585) now handles an accepted `freeSlot` as exactly one kernel `write`, through the authority that `meta_write_of_kinv` provides. `crel_kside` (LibRunner.lean:806-813) does the same, guarded by `kok`.
- (a) `freeSlot_meta_leaves` (l.1922): on reachable states it names the pool value `v`, proves `metaLeaves = footprint v`, gives `Grounds .modify v a`, and shows `Write3Step a (metaLeaves) L.kern (.ok L'.kern)` is accepted.
- (b) `freeSlot_kernel_write` (l.1938): it has no `Init` hypothesis and no reachability hypothesis. It proves `L'.kern = write3Eff …` and that every metadata leaf is `Init`. All other leaves keep their state, and the other 7 fields of `S3` (Basic.lean:143-151) are unchanged.
- The extended `meta_write_not_identity` shows `Moved → Init` on leaf 1 for an accepted `freeSlot`, with `PReach` of `m4`.
- `vst` gained place 7, and the original conjuncts are unchanged. This is needed because place 6 becomes `Init` through the transfer, and `AllocSlotStatic.dstNotInit` (l.168) then rules it out as the `allocSlot` destination. The decision's "prolongement" covers this.
- `FreeSlotStep.ok` has no `Write3Pre` field. This is stated in its docstring, follows the `allocSlot` precedent, and makes no difference on `KInv` states.
- Axioms: `#print axioms` on `meta_write_of_kinv`, `pstep_kernel`, `freeSlot_effect`, `freeSlot_meta_write`, `freeSlot_meta_leaves`, `freeSlot_kernel_write`, `freeSlot_abstract_update`, `freeSlot_meta_disjoint`, `Witness.meta_write_not_identity`, `crel_kside`, `pool_two_freeSlot_cross`, `pReach_reachable` and `kernel_guarantee` gives `[propext, Quot.sound]` for each. The forbidden-token grep printed nothing. The oleans are newer than the sources.

**Findings**

1. **Major.** `formal/Ern/Lib/HandlePool.lean:1962-1973` (`freeSlot_abstract_update`). Cause: formalization error; the theorem is weaker than decision (c).
   - The decision asks to prove that the abstract state (generation, free entry) "correspond aux métadonnées écrites".
   - The only conjuncts that link the abstract state to the write are `metaLeaves L'.kern pl' = metaLeaves L.kern pl` and `∀ l ∈ metaLeaves L'.kern pl', L'.kern.I l = .init`. Neither depends on the generation or the free flag.
   - Evidence: in a scratch file, `theorem metaLeaves_setSlot_any (s) (pl) (i) (x : Slot) : metaLeaves s (setSlot pl i x) = metaLeaves s pl := rfl` checks, with axioms `[propext, Quot.sound]`. So the same conjuncts hold for any slot value, for example `gen + 7` with `live = true`.
   - `S3` has no value component (Basic.lean:143-151; §38 `S₃=(F,P,I,A,D)`), and `write3Eff` changes only `I` (Ops.lean:648-649).
   - The parts "no extra memory right" (`A`, `D` unchanged) and the abstract update itself are proven.
